title: Reactors in all the craft are identical

tellings.quote: Apparently the reactors in all the craft are exactly the same.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret site called S4 in the Nevada desert in the late 1980s, says the reactors that powered the craft were apparently exactly the same in every one of them. If true, it would suggest the craft were built to one standard design, like a production line.
